newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE B shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE B shares up on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE B shares rose sharply and A SOLA BY fell fractionally in increased turnover on Friday on the Beirut Stock exchange.
B shares rose 2.96 percent to $117.1250 from Thursday's $113.75 and A shares fell to $113 from $113.75.
Turnover rose to 9,080 shares from 6,746 on Thursday, and value was $1,032,780.625 from $765,659.25.
There was no trade for the fifth successive day this week in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic. None of the shares were traded last week.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.06 percent to 84.41 and the BLOM stock index rose 0.20 percent to 979.40.
